title: createSlice
description: Learn how to create Redux slices with createSlice.

data.text: **createSlice** generates action creators and action types automatically based on your reducers. It uses Immer to let you write 'mutating' logic.

data.title: createSlice
Usage
Immer
data.text: createSlice uses Immer internally, so you can write 'mutating' code that's actually immutable. This is much cleaner than spread operators.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Much less boilerplate than classic Redux
data.takeaway: createSlice is the heart of modern Redux.
